title: Implement MARBLE MealMaster meal planner and pass the sealed suite
goal: Implement the MARBLE coding benchmark task MealMaster (task_id=51 in multiagentbench/coding/coding_main.jsonl at the pinned commit) as workspace/gc-326/solution.py per assets/gc-326/SPEC.md: constraint-filtered recipe candidates, a feasible 7-day plan generator with calorie tolerance, nutrition summaries, and validated meal swaps. Plan the constraint model first, then implement and verify in increments against the sealed suite, tracking which named tests are red after each run. Feasibility search must be shown to work (a red-to-green transition on the infeasibility test is expected evidence), and the final green run must be reproduced inside the pinned container.

spec.command: python -m pip install -q pytest==8.3.3 && python -m pytest assets/gc-326/test_accept.py -q --tb=no -p no:cacheprovider

process_expectations: A plan artifact exists before coding that states the candidate-filtering rules and the feasibility search strategy
The sealed suite was executed after each increment; at least one early red run and the final green run are logged
Red tests are tracked by pytest node id across iterations, not by count
Verification runs and their costs/outcomes are logged honestly, including failures
The sealed suite file is never edited; all fixes land in workspace/gc-326/solution.py
